# README

## About

**Title**: Reaction-condition sensitivity analysis for 1,3-cyclization

**Description**: Reaction-condition sensitivity analysis for 1,3-cyclization dataset version 1.0.0 generated by [PSDI Glorius Plot Generator](https://psdi-uk.github.io/psdi-glorius-plot/)

**Date Published**: 2025-12-04T12:01:01Z

**Dataset Version**: 1.0.0

**License**: [CC-BY-4.0](https://spdx.org/licenses/CC-BY-4.0.html)

**About**: This dataset enables users to visualise the sensitivity of a given chemical transformation to user-defined reaction conditions through the use of a Glorius Plot, based on [an original concept from the Glorius research group](https://doi.org/10.1002/anie.201901935).

## Bibliographic Information

**Name**: Fuhao ZHANG

- **ORCID**: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0649-2707

## File Structure

- [**ESI.pdf**](./ESI.pdf): A PDF electronic supplementary information file containing bibliographic information, details of the standard conditions for the experiment, preparation of the experimental conditions for the sensitivity assessment for the reaction, an image of the reaction, the results table for the sensitivity of the reaction, and the Glorius plot.
- **[ro-crate-metadata.json](./ro-crate-metadata.json)**: A machine-readable file describing the dataset contained within this Research Object Crate (RO-Crate).

- **data folder**:
  - [**reaction_scheme.cdxml**](./data/reaction_scheme.cdxml): ChemDraw file of the chemical transformation described by the Glorius plot.
  - [**standard_conditions.csv**](./data/standard_conditions.csv): Standard conditions for the chemical transformation plotted by the PSDI Glorius plot Generator.
  - [**test_conditions.csv**](./data/test_conditions.csv): Experimental description for each test condition plotted by the PSDI Glorius Plot Generator.

- **plot folder**:
  - [**glorius_plot.png**](./data/plot/glorius_plot.png): Image of Glorius plot generated by PSDI Glorius Plot Generator.
  - [**sensitivity_table.csv**](./data/plot/sensitivity_table.csv): Tabulated reaction outcomes for each test condition plotted by the PSDI Plot Generator.
  - [**user_preferences.json**](./data/plot/user_preferences.json): User preferences specified in PSDI Glorius Plot Generator.
